text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day in the gymnasium, while the entire academy
was abuzz with excitement over the U.A.F.—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of big sensations right now, the U.A.F.—
a festival of sports! And sports always need
a cute mascot!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, Vodka, Scarlet.
Mar-chan will do it. She will see it through."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make a huge impact at the U.A.F.
and snag that tournament mascot spot with a bang!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My goal, of course,
is winning the U.A.F.!
Well, it'll be a piece of cake anyway!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, I can't just let that slide! Obviously the one who's gonna win is me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win all 15 events
and show everyone that I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ha, if you're gonna talk like that, it's on, Scarlet!
Hey, Chan, pass us the ball!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Here I go~

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Uryaaa!! Receeeeeeive!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Swish-swish-swish!!
Swish-swish-swish-swish!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Chan-chan, over here too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Swish-swish-swish!!
Swish-swish-swish-swish!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Great job, great job, both of you.
Those were perfect receives. You're very skilled!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, with my skills, this much is a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Still, what was that?
Felt like something was off while doing it...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you too?
I was kind of curious about it, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Among the barrage of balls flying at me,
sometimes there seemed to be something weird mixed in..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoaaa!!!
Check it out, Scarlet, this ball!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh, over here too!?
Why is there a Chan-sticker on the ball?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh, you noticed. As expected of Vodka and Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I slipped a few balls featuring
my special Chan-mark among the vast sea of balls!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This will naturally imprint
Chan-Me's presence into the audience's memories.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And if a super play comes out,
I can even photobomb the slow-motion replay!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
After that, it's just a matter of how to sneak
the Chan-ball in among the actual balls—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Of course you can't do that during the real thing!
That's obviously out of the question for the real race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the days of practice continued—
